user_message: I spend 15k a month on Amazon. Which card should I get?

recommendations.card_name: Swiggy Ornge HDFC Bank Credit card

raw_response._format_hint: net_annual_savings = annual_rewards + milestone_benefits + lounge_value - annual_fee. Lead with this. top_spend_categories shows where savings come from.

fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank’s policy.
fees.annual_note: The annual fee is charged every year and may be waived if you meet the bank’s spending conditions.
fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹2 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.5% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.5₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card (minimum ₹500, if applicable)
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge of 1% is applied to transactions made for booking railway tickets
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Additional ₹100 is charged if Minimum Amount Due remains unpaid for two consecutive cycles, continuing until cleared

rewards.redemption_options: This is a cashback card, and the earned cashback is adjusted directly in your monthly statement.
rewards.exclusions: Fuel Transactions, Rent Payments, Wallet Loads, Cash Withdrawals, EMI Transactions, Fees & Charges, Government Payments, Education Payments, Insurance Premium Payments, Utility Bills Payments, Gift Card or Voucher Purchases, Reversed or Refunded Transactions, Gaming Platforms, Tolls
rewards.exclusion_spends: Fuel Transactions, Rent Payments, Wallet Loads, Cash Withdrawals, EMI Transactions, Fees & Charges, Government Payments, Education Payments, Insurance Premium Payments, Utility Bills Payments, Gift Card or Voucher Purchases, Reversed or Refunded Transactions, Gaming Platforms, Tolls

llm_raw_reply: HDFC Millennia, Amazon Pay ICICI Bank and Swiggy Ornge HDFC Bank come out level here, each saving around ₹9,000 a year. The real difference is the joining fee (₹1,180 for HDFC Millennia, Free for Amazon Pay ICICI Bank and ₹590 for Swiggy Ornge HDFC Bank). If you'd rather not pay to join, Amazon Pay ICICI Bank is the simpler pick.
